_comment: Copy to profiles.json to override the built-ins or add your own.
A name matching a built-in patches it; anything else defines a new profile.
Omit a field to inherit: provider follows THURSDAY_PROVIDER, effort follows
THURSDAY_EFFORT, and an empty model means the provider's default.

quick.description: Snappy factual answers, on a fast hosted model.

private.description: Anything that must not leave this machine.

translator.description: Translate between Thai and English, and explain word choices.
translator.style: Give the translation first, then a short note on anything ambiguous.
triggers: เป็นภาษาอังกฤษ

reader.description: Reading and summarising long documents and web pages.
reader.style: Summarise faithfully. Quote rather than paraphrase when precision matters.
